items.title: 4. Deforestation and Land Use for Urban Development (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 4. Deforestation and Land Use for Urban Development: a main subheading of 33.4 Water Pollution due to Human Activities, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 254-254.

blocks.text: Deforestation (darakht katna) aur land use (zameen ka istemal) pani ki pollution ko kafi barhate hain. Jab darakht aur vegetation (sabza) hata diye jate hain to mitti dheeli ho jati hai aur erosion (katne) ka zyada khatra hota hai, is liye daryaon aur naalon mein mitti (sediment) barh jati hai. Yeh mitti waterways (pani ke raaste) band karti, aquatic habitats (pani ke jaandaron ke ghar) kharab karti aur pani ki quality girati hai. Urban development aur construction (taameer) bhi runoff water (behte pani) mein pollutants aur debris (malba) daalti hai.
